name: snap-closet
description: Your Snap Closet wardrobe in the conversation: search and show the garments you own, add new ones from photos, get outfit suggestions, plan and log what you wear, and read a diagnosis of your closet.

interface.shortDescription: Your wardrobe in the chat: search it, get outfits, plan and log what you wear
interface.longDescription: Connects to your Snap Closet account over MCP. Ask what you own, search by category, colour, season or occasion, and see the garments as cards. Get outfit suggestions made only from your own clothes, put an outfit on a future day of the app's calendar, log what you wore, and read a diagnosis of your closet. Add new garments from photos: the server removes the background and tags them as the app does. Your agent receives garment tags and closet records; outfit photos, try-on images and fitting models are not shared.
defaultPrompt: What do I have in my closet?
Suggest an outfit for work tomorrow from my own clothes.
Help me add new garments to Snap Closet from photos.
